fields.Name: T218 - AI Agent Run Timeline Steps
fields.Description: Opens a completed AI Agent Run and verifies the Timeline tab shows the run's execution steps with type/duration/status — exercising MJ's agent-run detail UI.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' entity grid — type 'AI Agent Runs' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' node (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=MJ:%20AI%20Agent%20Runs). Click a row whose Status is 'Completed', then click 'Open Full Record'. The AI Agent Run detail opens with a header (the agent name e.g. 'Memory Manager', a COMPLETED badge, and Started/Completed/Duration/Result fields) and a row of tabs: Timeline, Visualization, Analytics, Details. On the default 'Timeline' tab, verify the run's execution STEPS are listed — each step shows a name (e.g. 'Agent Validation', 'Load Conversations With New Activity'), a Type (e.g. Validation or Decision), a duration in ms, and a Completed status. Confirm at least the run header (Duration, Result: Success) AND one or more timeline steps are visible. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Completed AI Agent Run record opened showing its run header (agent name, COMPLETED, Duration, Result)
The Timeline lists one or more execution steps, each with a name, type, duration, and status
No error messages or crash pages
